sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，特朗普总统表示他已经要求获取一份录音副本，尽管他也对录音的存在表示怀疑。

sentences.en: Are you surprised that they haven't turned it over?
sentences.zh: 他们没有交出录音，你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I'm not sure yet that it exists.
sentences.zh: 我还不确定它是否存在。

sentences.en: Probably does.
sentences.zh: 可能存在吧。

sentences.en: Possibly does.

sentences.en: Pressed by reporters on why he has seemed to defend Saudi Arabia's leaders in the face of growing evidence that Saudi agents murdered Khashoggi, Trump insisted he was not seeking

sentences.en: to protect them.

sentences.en: I'm not giving cover at all.
sentences.zh: 我根本没有在包庇任何人。

sentences.en: But he quickly reminded reporters of America's close economic ties to the Saudi kingdom.
sentences.zh: 但他很快提醒记者，美国与沙特王国有着密切的经济联系。

sentences.en: If you look at Saudi Arabia, they're an ally and they're a tremendous purchaser of not only military equipment, but other things.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看沙特阿拉伯，他们是盟友，而且他们不仅是军事装备的巨大买家，也是其他商品的巨大买家。

sentences.en: When I went there, they committed to purchase $450 billion worth of things and $110 billion worth of military.

sentences.en: Those are the biggest orders in the history of this country.
sentences.zh: 那是这个国家历史上最大的订单。

sentences.en: Probably the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 可能也是世界历史上的最大订单。
